text:
laura_cs: FYI customer (acme-corp) opened an escalation — after an incremental SCIM sync some users lost their product roles. Full import fixes it. They're on Okta SCIM with SSO-linked groups.

sam_engineering: Can you paste the exact SCIM PATCH payload they receive when the incremental runs? Also need the provisioning token scopes and the group externalId shape.

laura_cs: Pasting stripped payload (customer ok to share):
```
PATCH /Groups/00g1a2b3c4d5e6f7
Content-Type: application/scim+json

{
  "Operations": [
    {
      "op": "replace",
      "path": "members",
      "value": [
        { "value": "00u9x8y7z6", "display": "alice@acme.com" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```
Token scope: `scim:write` (we double-checked). Group externalId looks like `okta:group:00g1a2b3c4d5e6f7` (Okta pushes the prefix).

mike_infra: Quick thought — our mapping lookup historically expects externalId without provider prefix. If full import strips/normalizes differently than incremental patch handling, that could explain it. Did you see any mapping eval logs?

anya_se: I pulled the provisioning logs for that org, 2024-11-03 15:12 UTC. Relevant snippet:
```
INFO provisioning: scim.patch received group externalId=okta:group:00g1a2b3c4d5e6f7 org=acme-corp
DEBUG mapping-evaluator: lookup group by external_id=00g1a2b3c4d5e6f7 -> NOT FOUND
WARN role-assignment: no role mapping for group=okta:group:00g1a2b3c4d5e6f7
```
Looks like our evaluator is stripping prefixes on full imports but not on incremental patch paths — so the lookup fails and we skip role application.

sam_engineering: That aligns with a regression we shipped two weeks ago: PR #2209 changed normalization in the bulk importer to remove provider prefixes, but the live patch handler uses the raw externalId. Root cause: inconsistent normalization between import and patch code paths.

laura_cs: Customer impact: users added/removed via SSO group binding lost product role assignments until a manual full sync was run. They're hitting audit/complaint questions.

mike_infra: Proposed short-term fix: adjust patch handler to apply the same normalization function as bulk importer. Also add a guard to try both raw and stripped externalId in lookup to avoid future gaps.

sam_engineering: I'll own the hotfix. Plan:
1) small change to mapping-evaluator to try normalized and raw keys (hotfix) — staging test — deploy to prod (target 2h).
2) schedule backfill job to reconcile groups created since 2024-10-20 (when PR rolled) — run as customer-facing backfill, report per-org.
3) add unit tests to ensure both code paths use same normalization.

anya_se: I can run a quick query to enumerate orgs with recent GROUP_PATCH events where mapping failed and provide a list for CS to notify.

laura_cs: Please. Also would like a short blurb I can send to the customer explaining cause + mitigation + ETA.

sam_engineering: Draft blurb for CS: "We identified an internal inconsistency in how incremental SCIM patch events were matched to group-to-role mappings: group external IDs pushed by Okta include a provider prefix which our bulk import pipeline normalized, but the incremental patch handler did not. This caused role assignments to be skipped for some incremental updates. We've deployed a hotfix that attempts both normalized and raw external IDs for matching and scheduled a backfill to restore missing role assignments. We're notifying affected customers and will provide a reconciliation report."

incidents-bot: Created escalation ticket CS-6561 and linked to eng PR-2256.

laura_cs: Thanks — please ping here when hotfix is in prod and when the backfill is scheduled. I'll open a support case and share the reconciliation timeline with acme-corp. :thumbsup:
